text: The available satellite data (MODIS and VIIRS) shows no thermal anomalies or fire detections on the property from October 5, 2026, to November 3, 2026. However, there is no data for November 4, 2026, due to a temporal gap in satellite coverage. This means we cannot confirm whether the property remained fire-free on that final day. Small, short, or cloud-obscured fires might also go undetected.
